note: Requirements and executable checks, not a test-result receipt. The runner binds actual outcomes to one clean commit and installed wheel. Never convert a missing external prerequisite into a pass.

gaps.acceptance: Two clean offline exports yield identical wheels; installed files and retained wheel match source identity; image and dependency receipts are retained.
Current tool/scientific grants across direct and coordinated calls, resource isolation, handoff/reopen, queued revocation and whole-envelope bounds pass with zero unauthorized calls.
Durable local faults, surviving stale writers, owner continuity, atomic admission/publication and timeout uncertainty pass without re-execution.
Every mandatory phase passes without required skips, including installed MCP/SDK journeys and declared three-client sixty-second soak.

gaps.prerequisite: Host-approved CIW_NSR_CHECKOUT and CIW_SRA_CHECKOUT at the unchanged runtime pins, approved interpreter and official MCP transport dependency.
gaps.acceptance: Actual pinned children and installed SDK/MCP preserve full receipt content, occurrence semantics, non-authority, revocation, no-companion behavior, process/byte limits and surviving-process lease cleanup. Missing runtime evidence is not a pass; these profiles are not automatically exposed by the private HTTPS candidate.

gaps.acceptance: Latest eligible exact-SHA run/attempt, required job and retained validated artifact pass; existing research-policy gates remain intact.

gaps.prerequisite: Explicitly approved isolated ingress, principal credential mapping, DO/R2/container resources and corpus mounts; no credentials or deployment were created by local checks.
gaps.acceptance: Actual approved runtime proves authentication/revocation, private route isolation, live stale-writer fencing, owned restore and external-client journeys.

gaps.acceptance: Approved targets and operational drills meet measured requirements; local fixture targets are not substituted for customer SLOs.

gaps.acceptance: Only capabilities supported by exact applicable receipts are advertised as qualified; execution holds remain.

gaps.prerequisite: Approved durable ownership/retention design for upstream bundles beyond the existing owner budget.
